provenance.note: A woodblock: two resonators rung by one burst. A real quality factor of twelve on a bandpass rings for about as many cycles, which at 1.4 kHz is the ten milliseconds a block is, and the Q is the block's own hardness.

notes.boost: The make-up behind the resonators. A bandpass at a real quality factor of nine passes a ninth of an octave of a broadband burst, so what comes out of it is forty decibels under what went in; the gain is behind the filters, where it belongs, rather than hidden in the family trim.

provenance.moved: 10-03: three decibels down (trim 0.75 to 0.531, the declared loudness with it) — it clapped above the hats in the mix once the record's top opened
